scope: Single Chromium realm/context, exact emitted A original and B narrow DoubleSide grate material factories, shared real generated 25-layer texlib at 64px and shared authored Level top-face geometry. Nonpaintable production grate attributes; same zero-paint atlas, uniforms, camera/light, coverage and draw workload. Four front/back × top/bottom-light views. Independent reversed-normal/winding FrontSide oracle outside timing.
limitations: Component only; no full-game, startup/load, hardware GPU, heap, or general nondegradation claim.
64px real procedural texlib is a diagnostic resolution, not the production 256/512px library.
No world lightmap, mural, environment map, shadow map, postprocessing or simulation; these are identical between component A/B.
GPU elapsed-query durations are SwiftShader/driver observations; unsupported, missing, or disjoint results fail the run.
Intentional backside lighting changes are compared to an independent reversed-geometry oracle, not blanket A/B parity.

The oracle is restricted to this horizontal, nonpaintable pattern-12 grate: unchanged UV/tangent/position attributes, identity mesh transform, no stair remap, ink/wake/ripple slopes, mural, or see-through fade.
Its existing max-1/255 and at-most-1%-changed-pixels arithmetic tolerance is a separate component-oracle criterion; the committed PR FrontSide controls require exact zero changed pixels.
Timing starts after query begin/error checks and ends after gl.finish plus mandatory one-pixel readPixels. Full-frame reads, PNGs, validation and query polling remain outside timing.

interpretation.adoption: No adoption or zero-degradation conclusion follows from this component diagnostic.
interpretation.pairedObservation: Underlit front and back completed/GPU means are slower in both ABBA and BAAB blocks; top-lit views have opposite signs between their two blocks. No cause is established.
interpretation.pixelCriteria: Predeclared component oracle: max channel error <=1/255 and <=1% changed pixels. Separate from committed PR FrontSide controls, which require exactly zero changed pixels.
interpretation.drawRangeSerialization: The raw JSON null drawRange.count is JSON serialization of the untouched Three Infinity default; actual intercepted GL counts establish the six-index draw.
interpretation.images: Four backside before/after PNGs are copied; the raw receipt also retains hashes for eight uncopied front/oracle PNGs preserved in the original scratch directory.

oracleProof.preconditions: Identity mesh; horizontal nonpaintable pattern12; unchanged position/UV/tangent/flags/color attributes; identity slot remaps; zero stair metadata; no mural, see-through or active ink slopes.
oracleProof.sampling: Only normals and index winding change. UVs are cloned, not rebuilt. pid12 keeps the same texlib slot, coordinate transform, sampled normal/albedo/ORM and cutout masks. FaceData.y=0 keeps gInk/gInkD=0; gel/wake/ripple branches are inactive; USE_TEXLIB disables the fallback corrugation slope.
oracleProof.algebra: With N'=-N and unchanged F, T'=normalize(F-N'*dot(F,N'))=T; B'=cross(N',T')=-B. Reflecting sampled x yields q'=T*(-x*s)+(-B)*(y*s)+(-N)*z=-q. The original two-normalization FrontSide reference therefore has the candidate backside's expected direction, subject to floating-point bounds.
oracleProof.outsideScope: No proof for other material slots, paintable slopes, stairs, ramps, decals, arbitrary transformed geometry or Nintendo implementation.
